issues.on_page: Business-type Charges for Services 237,977 = Sales 237,320 + Other revenue 657 (p7)
issues.issue: The Statement of Activities (p2) counts the utility 'Other revenue' 657 in Charges for Services. Under the user ruling of 2026-11-06 it should be charges for services (Utility Charges), not other. The older 2026-10-23 category_decision is superseded.

issues.on_page: Cash and cash equivalents 165,311; County treasurer cash 4,000 (Total Governmental Funds)
